args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Rolled the service back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. First rollback attempt hit a partial failure (orchestrator error halted rollout after us-east, leaving us-west/eu-west on v2.3.1); retry completed the rollback successfully. Service is now healthy in all regions on v2.3.0 with a 0.2% error rate. Follow-up needed: root cause analysis of v2.3.1 and the orchestrator error during rollback.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: The first rollback attempt hit a partial failure (orchestrator error halted the rollout after us-east), leaving us-west and eu-west on the bad version. I retried and the rollback completed in all regions.
3. **Verified**: All regions are now on v2.3.0 and healthy, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy") documenting the failures, the rollback (including the partial-failure retry), the current healthy state, and follow-up items for RCA of both v2.3.1 and the orchestrator error. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the incident creation request returned a timeout error, but I confirmed via the incident list that it was successfully created and is open — I did not create a duplicate.
